translation: Any awakening hero who knows this training will never ruin it or lose their good conduct. They practice this to gain a Buddha's qualities. They are skilled in the higher training, and they know there is nothing to hold onto.

academic_translation:
Training in this way in the wisdom of the wise light-makers,
They do not generate even a single non-virtuous mind;
Just as, when overwhelmed by the rays of the sun moving in the sky,
Darkness does not remain in the space before it.
translation: By training in the wisdom of the wise light-makers, they do not have a single thought that is not good. Think of the sun moving across the sky. When the sun's bright rays shine, darkness cannot stay in the space before it.

academic_translation:
For those who have trained in the perfection of wisdom,
All the perfections come to be included here;
Just as the sixty-two views are included within the view of the transitory collection,
Likewise, it is taught that these perfections are included here.
translation: When someone trains in perfect wisdom, every other perfection is included right there. All sixty-two views are included inside the mistaken view of a self. In the same way, the Buddha teaches that all the other perfections are included inside this one.

academic_translation:
For example, when the life faculty ceases,
All other faculties, however many there are, cease;
Likewise, for the supreme wise ones who practice wisdom,
All perfections are taught to be gathered herein.
translation: When the life force stops, every other ability stops too. In the same way, for the great wise ones who practice wisdom, all the perfections are gathered right here.

Wise awakening heroes train in every good quality of a listener. They also train in all the good qualities of a solitary Buddha. They do not get stuck in them or wish for them. They just think, "This is what I must learn," and so they train.

academic_translation:
For those who have fully entered into supreme, irreversible awakening,
When one rejoices from the depths of one's heart in their generation of the mind of awakening,
The Mount Meru of the three thousandfold world system could be measured by weighing it on a scale,
But the virtue of that rejoicing is not like that.
translation: Some beings have fully entered into awakening with no turning back. If you truly rejoice in their making the wish to awaken, your goodness is huge. You could weigh Mount Meru of this vast system of worlds on a scale. But you cannot weigh the goodness of that rejoicing.

academic_translation:
However many sentient beings there are who seek virtue and desire to be of benefit,
One also rejoices in the aggregate of merit of them all;
Therefore, once they have attained the qualities of the Victors,
They give the gift of Dharma to the world in order to exhaust suffering.

locked_terms.use: good quality of the Victorious Ones

translation: Many living beings look for goodness and want to help others. One should also rejoice in the heap of stored-up goodness of them all. Because of this, once they gain every good quality of the Victorious Ones, they give the gift of teaching to the world to end suffering.

academic_translation:
Any bodhisattva who, being non-conceptual, fully knows all phenomena
As empty, signless, and free from elaboration,
Does not seek awakening through a dualistic wisdom;
That yogin strives in the supreme perfection of wisdom.

locked_terms.use: wisdom that splits things in two

translation: An awakening hero without made-up thoughts fully knows all things. They know things are empty, without signs, and free from tangled thinking. They do not seek awakening with a wisdom that splits things in two. That meditator works hard in the highest perfect wisdom.

academic_translation:
The element of space and what contradicts that space
Do not exist, and no one has attained it;
Likewise, the bodhisattva skilled in the practice of wisdom
Is like space, and practices total peace.
translation: The element of space and anything that goes against space do not exist. No one has ever attained it. In the same way, the awakening hero skilled in the practice of wisdom is like space. They practice complete peace.

academic_translation:
In the midst of people, an illusory person does not think,
"I must please these people," yet still does so;
Though seen displaying various miraculous powers,
They have no body, no mind, and not even a name.
translation: Think of a person made by magic standing in a crowd. This illusion does not think, "I must make these people happy." But they do it anyway! People see them showing off many magic powers. Yet they have no body, no mind, and not even a name.

academic_translation:
Likewise, those who practice wisdom never think,
"Having realized awakening, I will completely liberate beings";
Endowed with various births and many activities,
Though displaying them like an illusion, they practice non-conceptually.
translation: In the same way, those who practice wisdom never think, "After I reach awakening, I will completely free all beings." They take on many kinds of births and do many things. They show these things like an illusion. Yet they practice without fixed ideas.

academic_translation:
For example, an emanation of a Buddha performs the deeds of a Buddha,
Yet in doing so, not even the slightest pride arises;
Likewise, the bodhisattva skilled in practicing wisdom
Displays all activities like an emanation and an illusion.
translation: For example, a magic copy of a Buddha performs a Buddha's deed. But it feels no pride at all. In the same way, an awakening hero is skilled in practicing wisdom. They show all their actions like a magic creation and an illusion.

academic_translation:
A skilled carpenter crafts figures resembling men and women,
And they too perform all activities;
Likewise, the bodhisattva skilled in practicing wisdom
Performs all activities through non-conceptual primordial wisdom.
translation: A skilled carpenter makes figures that look like men and women. These figures can do all kinds of tasks. In the same way, an awakening hero is skilled in practicing wisdom. They do all their actions through deep knowing free of thoughts.

academic_translation:
To those skilled in practicing thus, many hosts of gods
Join palms, bow down, and pay homage;
And however many Buddhas there are in the world systems of the ten directions,
They completely proclaim garlands of praise for their qualities.
translation: When someone is skilled in practicing like this, a huge crowd of gods will put palms together. They bow down and show respect. There are many Buddhas in the world systems of the ten directions. All these Buddhas speak endless praise for their good qualities.

academic_translation:
However many sentient beings there are in realms equal to the Ganges,
If all of them were to take up the intention and become Māras,
And even if they emanated that many more from every single hair,
All of them could not create obstacles for the wise.
translation: Think of all the living beings in worlds as many as the Ganges. Suppose they all decided to become Maras. Suppose each one made even more Maras from every single hair! Even then, they could not make obstacles for the wise.

academic_translation:
Through four causes, the wise bodhisattva is strong,
Difficult for the four Māras to overcome and impossible to shake:
Dwelling in emptiness, not forsaking sentient beings,
Acting exactly as they speak, and possessing the blessing of the Sugatas.
translation: A wise awakening hero is strong because of four causes. The four Maras cannot beat them or shake them. First, they rest in emptiness. Second, they never give up on living beings. Third, they do exactly what they say. Fourth, they have the blessing of the Well-Gone Ones.

academic_translation:
When this perfection of wisdom, the Mother of the Tathāgatas,
Is taught, whichever bodhisattva aspires to it,
And exerts themselves in accomplishing it with sincere intent,
That noble one should be known to have entered into omniscience.
translation: This perfect wisdom is the Mother of the Thus-Gone Ones. When it is taught, an awakening hero might wish to learn it. If they try hard to master it with a true heart, you should know something about this noble person. They have stepped onto the path of knowing everything.

academic_translation:
They do not dwell in the dharmadhātu or suchness,
But, for example, like a cloud in space, they dwell without dwelling.
A mantra-holder, traveling in space without a dwelling, wishing to dwell,
Through the power of mantra, brings forth out-of-season flowers and empowers the place as they wish.
translation: They do not stay stuck in the expanse of all things or the way things really are. Instead, they rest without resting, just like a cloud in the sky. Think of a holder of magic words flying through the air. If they want to rest, they use words of power to grow flowers out of season. Then they bless the spot just as they please.

When practicing like this, a wise and bright awakening hero does not cling to the mind that understands. They do not cling to a Buddha's qualities. They do not grasp at a teacher, a person who wants the teaching, or someone with a certain view. This is how people live when they want peace and love every good quality.

academic_translation:
Except for the liberation of the arhats and the Tathāgatas,
This dwelling is the supreme and unsurpassed among all
The dwellings of śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas in peaceful samādhi,
Profoundly peaceful and endowed with bliss, however many there are.
translation: A listener or a solitary Buddha can rest in deep calm. Their rest is very peaceful and full of joy. But the way an awakening hero rests is even better than all of those. It is the very best, beaten only by the freedom of a worthy one or a Thus-Gone One.

Birds live in the sky, but they do not fall. Fish live in the water, but they do not drown. In the same way, an awakening hero uses the power of deep focus to reach the far shore. They rest in emptiness, but they do not slip away into peace beyond sorrow.

academic_translation:
Whoever wishes to reach the pinnacle of the qualities of all sentient beings,
And touch the supreme, most marvelous primordial wisdom of a Buddha,
And give the most excellent, supreme, and holy gift of Dharma,
Should rely on this supreme dwelling of the benefactors.
translation: Some may wish to reach the highest good qualities of all living beings. They may want to touch a Buddha's deep knowing, which is supreme and wonderful. They may wish to give the best and holiest gift of teaching. To do this, they should rely on this perfect home of the helpers.

academic_translation:
When the Guides fully proclaim the trainings, this training
Is supreme and unsurpassed among all trainings, however many there are.
Any wise person who wishes to go to the far shore of all trainings
Should train in this perfection of wisdom, the training of the Buddhas.
translation: The Guides teach about many trainings. But this training is the highest and best of them all. A wise person may wish to go to the far shore of all trainings. To do this, they should train in perfect wisdom. This is the training of the Buddhas.

academic_translation:
This is the supreme treasure of Dharma and the holy Dharma treasury;
It is the Buddha family, the treasury of happiness and joy for beings.
The Protectors of the World of the past, the future, and the ten directions—
All of them arise from this, yet the dharmadhātu is never exhausted.
translation: This is the supreme treasure of teaching and the holy treasury of the teaching. It is the Buddha family. It is a treasury of happiness and joy for beings. The Protectors of the world live in the past, the future, and the ten directions. All of them are born from this. Yet the expanse of all things never runs out.

academic_translation:
However many trees, fruits, flowers, and forests there are,
They all perfectly arise and emerge from the earth;
Yet the earth is neither exhausted nor increased,
It does not diminish, is non-conceptual, and has no weariness.
translation: Think of all the trees, fruits, flowers, and forests. They all perfectly arise and come from the earth. Yet the earth itself is never used up, and it does not grow larger. It never shrinks. It is without fixed ideas, and it never grows tired.

academic_translation:
The sons of the Buddha, the śrāvakas, the pratyekabuddhas, and the gods,
And however many phenomena of happiness and joy there are for all beings—
They all arise from the supreme perfection of wisdom,
Yet wisdom is neither exhausted nor increased.
translation: Think of the children of the Buddha, the listeners, the solitary Buddhas, and the gods. Think of all the happy and joyful things for beings. All of them arise from supreme perfect wisdom. Yet this wisdom is never used up, and it never grows larger.

academic_translation:
However many sentient beings there are—inferior, middling, and supreme—
The Sugata taught that they all arise from ignorance.
When conditions assemble, the machine of suffering fully arises,
Yet that machine of ignorance is neither exhausted nor increased.
translation: There are low, medium, and supreme living beings. The Well-Gone One taught that they all arise from ignorance. When helping causes come together, the machine of suffering fully arises. Yet that machine of ignorance is never used up, and it never grows larger.

academic_translation:
However many primordial wisdoms, approaches, gateways, skillful means, and roots there are,
All these arise from the supreme perfection of wisdom;
When conditions assemble, the machine of karma fully emerges,
Yet the perfection of wisdom has no exhaustion and no increase.
translation: There are many kinds of deep knowing, approaches, gateways, clever ways, and roots. They all come from supreme perfect wisdom. When helping causes gather, the machine of deeds starts to work. Yet perfect wisdom never runs out, and it never grows larger.
